# Vector Consulting Limited

> Hong Kong technology consultancy delivering senior engineering teams, applied AI and federated data spaces to companies in Europe and Asia.

- Registered in Hong Kong, Business Registration No. 72876645. Address: Rooms 1705-1709, 17/F, Tung Chiu Commercial Centre, 193 Lockhart Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong.
- Contact: alison.lindsay@vectorconsultingltd.com
- Services: software engineering, dedicated engineering teams, AI and data (sovereign AI, data platforms, federated data spaces on Gaia-X / IDSA / Pontus-X with ODRL usage policies), technology consulting including EU-funded R&D.
- Industries: healthcare and life sciences, procurement and public sector, technology companies, industrial data spaces.
- Engagement models: project delivery, dedicated team, specialists, advisory.
- Selected work: Global Data Care federated health data space (technology development for Accuro Technology, Spain); PROCUREDATA procurement data space (advisory for Agile Procurement via Accuro Technology); senior specialists for Spanish technology companies, including through Technova Corp Ltd (London).

## Videos (animated explainers, EN/ES, AI-generated voice-over)
- [One accountable partner](https://www.vectorconsultingltd.com/videos/v01/): Who owns your project when it gets hard? Five vendors, five contracts… and nobody accountable. Vector brings strategy, architecture and delivery under one roof. From Hong Kong, with delivery capacity in Madrid and London. Software engineering, dedicated teams, AI and data, and technology consulting. Built for European rules: GDPR, the AI Act and Gaia-X data spaces. Senior by default. One accountable partner. Vector Consulting.
- [Global Data Care: the data stays home](https://www.vectorconsultingltd.com/videos/v02/): How do hospitals share data without giving it away? Hospitals, researchers and health-tech companies each keep their data at source. The data stays home. What travels is a usage policy: who, for what, and until when. Only verified participants on the trust list can join. Patient consent is enforced on the server, not just hidden on screen. A working federated health data space, built on European standards. Global Data Care. Built by Vector for Accuro Technology.
- [PROCUREDATA: data entered once](https://www.vectorconsultingltd.com/videos/v03/): How many times does a supplier type the same data? The same certificate, re-entered in portal after portal. With PROCUREDATA, the supplier publishes it once, as a data package. Nothing flows without an approved transaction and a valid usage policy. The buyer's ERP fills in the form automatically, on approval or on demand. AI proposes; the policy decides. And there is no central data store. Data entered once, consumed under governance. PROCUREDATA.
- [Senior talent, one accountable partner](https://www.vectorconsultingltd.com/videos/v04/): Need a senior engineer next month, not next quarter? Traditional hiring is slow, and projects can't wait. Vector selects senior profiles that match your stack and your culture. They join your tools and rituals. You keep control of priorities. Specialists working from several countries, including London. And if someone has to change, we guarantee continuity. Senior capacity, when your project needs it. Vector Consulting.
